import os
from build123d import *

R_RING_IN, R_RING_OUT, H_RING = 0.023, 0.030, 0.010
R_SPIN_OUT, R_SPIN_IN, H_SPIN = 0.022, 0.015, 0.008

ring_bore = Cylinder(R_RING_IN, H_RING)
spinner   = Cylinder(R_SPIN_OUT, H_SPIN) - Cylinder(R_SPIN_IN, H_SPIN)
oil = ring_bore - spinner

print("oil volume m^3:", oil.volume)
bb = oil.bounding_box()
print("bbox min", bb.min, "max", bb.max)
print("radial clearance mm:", (R_RING_IN-R_SPIN_OUT)*1000,
      " axial gap mm:", (H_RING-H_SPIN)/2*1000)
print("n faces:", len(oil.faces()), " solids:", len(oil.solids()))

import os, numpy as np
os.makedirs("constant/triSurface", exist_ok=True)
F = oil.faces()
patches = {
    "ring_wall":       [F[0]],
    "ring_end_top":    [F[1]],
    "ring_end_bottom": [F[2]],
    "spinner_wall":    [F[3], F[4], F[5], F[6]],
}
for name, fl in patches.items():
    shp = Compound(children=[Face(f.wrapped) for f in fl]) if len(fl) > 1 else fl[0]
    export_stl(shp, f"constant/triSurface/{name}.stl", tolerance=2e-6, angular_tolerance=0.05)
    print(name, "%.6e m2"%sum(f.area for f in fl), os.path.getsize(f"constant/triSurface/{name}.stl"))
print("total area", sum(f.area for f in F))
